description: F-104A on a concrete base at Umm al-Aswad in the Wadi as-Sir district of west Amman, described by the International F-104 Society as a guard near the tomb of the late Queen Alia on Ahl al-Bayt road. It carries the false serial 752. The F-104 society attributes it to 923, construction number 183-1081, while spottingmode leaves the registration blank and records only the marking, so no tail number is asserted. Its original canopy is missing and the split tailplane shows Mirage F1 decoy service at Mafraq.
